metadata_used.title: Flight Attendants Aren't Drink Servers — They're Safety Crew ✈️
metadata_used.description: Flight attendants are trained safety crew. This sourced paper-collage Short explains emergency training, the 90-second certification standard, the door greeting, and the changing pay clock.

metadata.hero_frame_notes: Use the opening service-to-fire-extinguisher transformation; it communicates the myth reversal without relying on small text.
metadata.thumbnail_concept: Coffee pot morphing into a coral fire extinguisher, with the cut-paper headline NOT JUST DRINKS.
metadata.platform_notes: Native 9:16, 1080x1920, 70 seconds, H.264/AAC, word-level captions baked in, SRT sidecar included. Exported locally; no external account upload was authorized.
